answer_1.quote: A question-answering system is designed to extract information by converting a natural language question into a structured query that can retrieve precise information from an existing knowledge base.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include structured SPARQL queries and natural language answers derived from knowledge bases or LLM internal knowledge.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics precision(P), recall(R), and F1-score(F1) are reported.
